why: Resolves the one palette setting that has nothing to resolve to a constant, and picks the constant that hides it: Classic, what every player saw before the control existed (issue #1058; modelled on effective-settings-quality-ignores-the-store). Both consumers read the effective value -- the Settings control paints from it and `loop.ts` builds the session from it -- so the store keeps the choice, the toggle keeps writing it, and nothing anywhere ever draws in High contrast. The three suites are the three places the value should arrive.
killedBy: resolveEffectiveSettings: audio, UI scale and quality pass through ungated passes the owner palette straight through, on any capability set (issue #1058)
createRouteHost: the Main Menu is painted from the stores by the page paints the STORED owner palette on a page with no session
startGameWith: dev flags stay off by default builds the session in the STORED owner palette when no flag is set (issue #1058)
